summary_en: ¥90M special dividend received from CN Innovations Holdings Limited (USD 259k + HKD 2,362k). Payment represents escrow settlement and adjustment between selling shareholders and continuing shareholders following MBK's 2022 sale of its CNI stake. CNI to continue annual special dividends through FY2026 per agreement with acquirer.
title_en: Notice of Receipt of Special Dividend from CN Innovations Holdings Limited
translation_en_brief: MBK Co., Ltd. received a special dividend of ¥90M (USD 259k + HKD 2,362k) from CN Innovations Holdings Limited on 24 June 2026. MBK originally acquired CNI shares in 2007 and sold its entire 1.226% stake (11,262 shares) in March 2022 to CNI's major shareholder for ¥848M (generating a gain of ¥526M on a book value of ¥321M). At the time of sale, MBK agreed contractually to deposit USD 941k with CNI as an escrow reserve to cover expected costs of CNI's restructuring and MBK's taxes. The current special dividend represents both a payout under the shareholders' interest-adjustment clause (which entitled selling shareholders to continue receiving distributions post-exit) and partial release of the escrow deposit, with an estimated remaining balance of USD 87k. CNI has indicated special dividends will continue through 2026 per the plan disclosed to MBK, though the timing and amounts of future payments are not firm. The ¥90M will be recorded in Q3 FY10/26 revenue and offset by an equivalent profit entry. MBK notes it will reassess the impact on full-year results as needed.
